body parts/kidney: "is about the size of a closed fist": the usual textbook comparison; an adult kidney is about 10 to 12 cm long, so it is approximate
body parts/liver: "weighs about one and a half kilograms in an adult": typical adult range is roughly 1.2 to 1.6 kg, so 'about' carries the claim
"can be transplanted from a living donor": a living donor gives only a portion of the liver, which regrows in both people
body parts/lung: "is soft and pinkish in a healthy adult": healthy lung tissue is pink, but adult lungs often show grey mottling from inhaled particles
body parts/skull: "tends to be larger and heavier in men": true on average only; individuals overlap widely
body parts/stomach: "can cause a burning pain that rises into the chest": heartburn is stomach acid rising into the gullet; the stomach is the source, the burning is felt behind the breastbone
body parts/tongue: "heals remarkably quickly after a small cut or burn": mouth tissue generally heals faster than skin; stated as a general tendency
